relationships.description: Moiraine orchestrates events around Rand, providing him with fine clothes including one bearing the Dragon sigil, but refuses to speak to him directly. Rand feels she is manipulating him and fears her attention.
The Amyrlin has come to Fal Dara specifically to see Rand and his friends. Rand is terrified of her and desperately trying to flee before she can summon him. Her gaze makes him flinch.
Agelmar shows deep respect and offers full hospitality to the Amyrlin Seat, placing his house and fortress at her disposal. She honors him and his house in return.
Counterparts in managing Fal Dara keep: Elansu as shatayan (housekeeper) and Ronan as shambayan (major-domo and secretary). Elansu leaves little for Ronan except ceremonies.
Brother and sister. Amalisa is Lord Agelmar's sister.
Friends and roommates sharing quarters in Fal Dara. Both from the Two Rivers.
Friends and roommates sharing quarters in Fal Dara. Both from the Two Rivers.
Thom taught Rand to play the flute and gave him his gleeman's cloak before sacrificing himself facing a Myrddraal to save Rand. Rand carries Thom's possessions and remembers him with grief.
Father (or adoptive father) and son. Rand thinks of Tam's Westwood farm as home.
Rand owns Red, a tall bay stallion kept in the Lord's Stable, and attempts to have him saddled for escape.
Tema serves Rand as head groom, though he mistakenly treats Rand as a lord despite Rand's protests.
